title: Step 1a - Building a Logistic Regression Model for Customer Behavior Prediction

cues.en: -: Hello my friends.
cues.zh: 大家好。

cues.en: Welcome to this new practical activity and the first practical activity actually of part three, classification.
cues.zh: 歡迎來到新的實作，也是第三部分分類的第一個實作。

cues.en: I'm super excited, as you might hear, by the sound of my voice, because this is one of my favorite parts, and actually you will see that the case study we will do together is pretty fun.
cues.zh: 你應該聽得出來，我很興奮，因為這是我最喜歡的部分之一，案例也很有趣。

cues.en: So, I can't wait to start.
cues.zh: 我迫不及待要開始。

cues.en: Welcome back and so now here we go.
cues.zh: 歡迎回來，現在開始。

cues.en: We are about to enter a new branch of machine learning where, this time, we won't predict a continuous numerical value, like in part two, regression,
cues.zh: 我們進入機器學習的新分支，這次不像第二部分迴歸，預測連續數值，

cues.en: but this time we will predict a category, you know, a class.
cues.zh: 而是預測類別。

cues.en: Like, for example, you know, a binary variable, zero or one.
cues.zh: 例如二元變數 0 或 1。

cues.en: One classic example is actually to do classification to predict a tumor.
cues.zh: 經典例子，是分類腫瘤。

cues.en: You know, whether a tumor is benign or malignant, and this is actually the case study we'll do at the end, you know, when I will teach you on how to select the best classification model,
cues.zh: 判斷良性或惡性。這也是最後學習選擇最佳分類模型時，要做的案例，

cues.en: but that will come at the end.
cues.zh: 不過留到最後。

cues.en: First, we will do a fun case study with which we will learn how to build each of our classification models, and there you go, my friends, it is in this tutorial
cues.zh: 先透過有趣案例學習建立各種分類模型，就在這個教學，

cues.en: that I will explain the problem of this case study.
cues.zh: 我會說明案例問題。

cues.en: All right, so before we start, let's just make sure once again, everyone here is on the same page.
cues.zh: 開始前，確認大家在同一頁面。

cues.en: So, right before this tutorial, I give you the link to this folder containing all the codes and data sets in the 10 parts.
cues.zh: 教學之前已提供連結，資料夾包含十個部分的程式與資料集。

cues.en: So make sure to connect to that link, and now, now we should all be on the same page, and there you go.
cues.zh: 請開啟連結，現在大家應該都在這裡。

cues.en: We're gonna go into part three classification to tackle our first model logistic regression.
cues.zh: 進入 Part 3 Classification，開始第一個模型：邏輯斯迴歸。

cues.en: I hope you enjoyed the intuition lectures and mostly that you're now ready to put your well-learned theory into practice, and we're gonna put it into practice first with Python,
cues.zh: 希望你喜歡直覺教學，也準備好把理論付諸實作；先從 Python 開始，

cues.en: with which we're going to re-implement from scratch and step-by-step the whole logistic regression implementation.
cues.zh: 從頭逐步重寫完整的邏輯斯迴歸程式。

cues.en: So, as you can see in this Python folder, you have two files.
cues.zh: Python 資料夾有兩個檔案。

cues.en: First, well that logistic regression implementation in ipynb format, which you can open with either Google colaboratory or Jupyter Notebook,
cues.zh: 一個是 ipynb 格式的實作，可用 Google Colaboratory 或 Jupyter Notebook 開啟，

cues.en: and you have the data set, which is called Social Network Ads.
cues.zh: 另一個是 Social Network Ads 資料集。

cues.en: So, let's open it, and now let me explain what the problem is about.
cues.zh: 開啟資料，讓我說明問題。

cues.en: All right, so let's imagine our favorite car company.
cues.zh: 想像你最喜歡的汽車公司。

cues.en: I won't mention a name here because I don't wanna do any kind of advertising, but let's imagine your favorite car company, and let's imagine that you are a data scientist
cues.zh: 我不提品牌，避免廣告；假設你是該公司的資料科學家，

cues.en: for that company and your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to predict which of your previous customers
cues.zh: 你的任務，若願意接受，就是預測哪些既有顧客

cues.en: will buy a brand new, beautiful SUV just created by your favorite car company.
cues.zh: 會購買公司剛推出的全新漂亮 SUV。

cues.en: All right, so your favorite car company has just released this brand new, beautiful, irresistible SUV, and the general manager of this car company has asked you,
cues.zh: 公司剛發布這輛令人心動的新 SUV，總經理找上你，

cues.en: you know, the most talented data scientist of the company, to predict which customers will buy that new SUV, you know, with the highest conversion rate.
cues.zh: 這位公司最有才華的資料科學家，要求預測哪些顧客會買，以取得最高轉換率。

cues.en: and to help you because, you know, this general manager has some minimum data science skills and knows and understands that in order to predict this, you need data, right?
cues.zh: 總經理具備一些基本資料科學知識，知道要做預測，需要資料，

cues.en: You need data on which to train your classification model to predict what needs to be predicted, meaning which customers will buy that brand new SUV,
cues.zh: 要用資料訓練分類模型，預測哪些顧客會買新 SUV。

cues.en: and so there you go.
cues.zh: 因此，

cues.en: That's exactly the data that your general manager gave you, and in this data set, well, each row corresponds to different customers
cues.zh: 他提供了這份資料集，每列對應不同顧客，

cues.en: and for each of these customers, there you go, I'm about to reveal the features and the dependent variable for each of these customers.
cues.zh: 每個顧客的特徵與應變數如下。

cues.en: While this general manager collected the age and it collected the estimated salary because, you know, when a customer buys a new car with some kind of credit or whatever,
cues.zh: 他蒐集了年齡與估計薪資，因為顧客貸款買車等情況時，

cues.en: well, it has to provide the estimated salary in the form.
cues.zh: 表格中需要填估計薪資。

cues.en: So, that's how it got estimated salary, and finally, that's your dependent variable, of course, the purchased variable, telling whether or not these customers
cues.zh: 這就是薪資來源；最後是應變數 Purchased，表示這些顧客

cues.en: have bought, previously, some older SUVs of this car company, right?
cues.zh: 過去是否買過公司的舊款 SUV。

cues.en: So, this car company has basically many makes and models of SUVs, and all the zeros and the ones that you see here for each customer is saying whether or not
cues.zh: 公司有很多款 SUV，這裡每個人的 0 與 1，表示是否

cues.en: these customers have bought one of these previous SUVs so that your model will be trained on this data set, and for new customers, you know, having a different age
cues.zh: 買過舊款。模型會用這份資料訓練，之後對年齡

cues.en: and a different estimated salary, well, we will predict if yes or no, they will buy that new SUV.
cues.zh: 與估計薪資不同的新顧客，預測會不會買新 SUV。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So, of course in this dependent variable purchased, zero means that the customer didn't buy any previous SUV, and one means that the customer bought some previous SUVs.
cues.zh: Purchased 中，0 表示過去沒有買過 SUV，1 表示買過。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And therefore, all the future predictions that will be equal to one ,will probably mean that the customer has a high chance to buy the new SUV,
cues.zh: 因此未來預測為 1，可能代表這位顧客有很高機會買新 SUV，

cues.en: if of course, we offer a great deal, and finally, once we predict the customers that are gonna buy the SUV, while the final step of the strategy will be
cues.zh: 當然也要提供好方案。預測出會買的顧客後，策略最後一步，

cues.en: for the advertising team to post ads of this brand new SUV on social networks, and these ads will be targeted to the customers where we predict one, you know
cues.zh: 是廣告團隊在社群媒體刊登新 SUV 廣告，鎖定我們預測為 1 的顧客，

cues.en: where we predict that they're gonna buy that new SUV.
cues.zh: 也就是預測可能會買的人。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So, you see the idea?
cues.zh: 了解這個想法了嗎？

cues.en: the predictive model will target your customers, and then the advertising team will use the results of this predictive model to optimize the targeting of future customers.
cues.zh: 預測模型找出目標顧客，廣告團隊再用結果最佳化未來顧客的鎖定。

cues.en: And that is why you know, the name of the data set is called Social_Network_Ads.csv.
cues.zh: 所以資料集才叫 Social_Network_Ads.csv。
